svg.title: Phase plane of a toggle switch between two transcription factors
svg.desc: Levels of regulator A on the horizontal axis and regulator B on the vertical axis. The two nullclines cross three times: two stable states, A on with B off and B on with A off, and an unstable saddle on the diagonal, which separates the two basins. Trajectories starting on either side of the diagonal end in different states.
svg.text: A toggle switch: two regulators that repress each other
Blue zone: ends in fate A.
Pink zone: ends in fate B.
